name: tc-netem-netem-delay-drop-unrelated-above
description: netem-delay with a drop for a different address above
setup: nft add chain inet f out "{ type filter hook output priority 0; policy accept; }"
nft add rule inet f out ip daddr 10.9.9.9 drop

action.spec: tc qdisc add dev veth0 root netem delay 100ms
